king = {};
mx.events.EventDispatcher.initialize(king);
nupu = new Object();
nupu.type = "onzhu";
gb = function()
{
   king.dispatchEvent(nupu);
};
var ng = new Object();
var v = ggv = hudu = vx = vy = zxc = xs5 = xx5 = csj = bgf = xsq = xs10 = xx10 = xx2 = xs2 = xs = xx1 = w = jiao = 0;
var h = caoji = false;
var hkk = true;
var gg_Obj = new Object();
var z = 30;
var pl = 0;
gg_Obj.onKeyDown = function()
{
   if(Key.getCode() == 39)
   {
      v = z;
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 37)
   {
      v = - z;
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 38)
   {
      hudu += 0.03;
      qmm_mc.jiantou1_mc.gotoAndStop(2);
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 40)
   {
      hudu -= 0.03;
      qmm_mc.jiantou2_mc.gotoAndStop(2);
   }
};
gg_Obj.onKeyUp = function()
{
   v = 0;
   if(Key.getCode() == 39)
   {
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 37)
   {
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 38)
   {
      qmm_mc.jiantou1_mc.gotoAndStop(1);
   }
   if(Key.getCode() == 40)
   {
      qmm_mc.jiantou2_mc.gotoAndStop(1);
   }
};
Key.addListener(gg_Obj);
king.addEventListener("onzhu",qgg_mc);
qgg_mc.onzhu = function()
{
   qggyz._x += v;
   if(qggyz._x < -140)
   {
      qggyz._x = -140;
   }
   if(qggyz._x > 260)
   {
      qggyz._x = 260;
   }
   qgg_mc._x = ggv = qgg_mc._x + (qggyz._x - qgg_mc._x) * 0.2;
   if(qggyz._x - qgg_mc._x > 40)
   {
      qgg_mc.qi.gotoAndStop(2);
   }
   if(qggyz._x - qgg_mc._x < -40)
   {
      qgg_mc.qi.gotoAndStop(3);
   }
   if(qggyz._x - qgg_mc._x > -30 && qggyz._x - qgg_mc._x < 40)
   {
      qgg_mc.qi.gotoAndStop(1);
   }
};
var fx = fy = iuy = 1;
var shudu = 10;
qmmyd = function()
{
   while(jiao == 0)
   {
      jiao = random(400);
      hudu = jiao * 0.017;
      if(jiao < 200)
      {
         jiao = 0;
      }
      if(jiao > 245 && jiao < 295)
      {
         jiao = 0;
      }
      if(jiao > 340)
      {
         jiao = 0;
      }
   }
   vx = Math.cos(hudu) * shudu;
   vy = Math.sin(hudu) * shudu;
   qmm_mc._x += iuy * fx * vx;
   qmm_mc._y += fy * vy;
};
var ljk = Object();
var ljjk = Object();
penzhuang = function()
{
   ljk.x = qmm_mc._x;
   ljk.y = qmm_mc._y;
   ljjk.x = qgg_mc._x;
   ljjk.y = qgg_mc._y;
   this.localToGlobal(ljjk);
   this.localToGlobal(ljk);
   if(hkk && qmm_mc._currentframe < 3)
   {
      if((zuopt1_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || zuopt2_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)) && hkk)
      {
         shudu = 15;
         pl = 0;
         if(fx > 0)
         {
            fx = -1;
         }
         else
         {
            fx = 1;
         }
         hkk = false;
         if(zuopt1_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true))
         {
            zuopt1_mc.zuox1.qfg.gotoAndPlay(2);
         }
         if(zuopt2_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true))
         {
            zuopt2_mc.zuox2.qfg.gotoAndPlay(2);
         }
      }
      if(youpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && hkk)
      {
         shudu = 15;
         pl = 0;
         if(fx > 0)
         {
            fx = -1;
         }
         else
         {
            fx = 1;
         }
         hkk = false;
         youpt_mc.you1.qfg.gotoAndPlay(2);
      }
      if(shangpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && hkk)
      {
         shudu = 15;
         if(fy > 0)
         {
            fy = -1;
         }
         else
         {
            fy = 1;
         }
         hkk = false;
         shangpt_mc.gotoAndPlay(2);
      }
      if((qgg_mc.pb.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || qgg_mc.pb1.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || qgg_mc.pb2.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)) && hkk && qmm_mc._currentframe < 3)
      {
         shudu = 15;
         pl = 0;
         if(qgg_mc.pb1.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && hkk)
         {
            hkk = false;
            if(qmm_mc._x < 0 && vx < 0)
            {
               fx = -1;
               iuy = -1;
            }
            else
            {
               fx = 1;
            }
         }
         if(qgg_mc.pb2.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && hkk)
         {
            hkk = false;
            if(jiao < 270 && vx < 0)
            {
               fx = -1;
            }
            else
            {
               fx = 1;
            }
         }
         if(qgg_mc.pb.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && hkk)
         {
            if(fy > 0)
            {
               fy = -1;
            }
            else
            {
               fy = 1;
            }
            if(fx * vx < 0 && qggyz._x < qgg_mc._x && hkk && qgg_mc.qi._currentframe == 3)
            {
               hkk = false;
               hudu -= ggv * 0.0002;
            }
            if(fx * vx > 0 && qggyz._x > qgg_mc._x && hkk && qgg_mc.qi._currentframe == 2)
            {
               hkk = false;
               hudu += ggv * 0.005;
            }
            if(fx * vx < 0 && qgg_mc.qi._currentframe == 2 && hkk)
            {
               hkk = false;
               if(fx > 0)
               {
                  fx = -1;
               }
               else
               {
                  fx = 1;
               }
            }
            if(fx * vx > 0 && qgg_mc.qi._currentframe == 3 && hkk)
            {
               hkk = false;
               if(fx > 0)
               {
                  fx = -1;
               }
               else
               {
                  fx = 1;
               }
            }
            qgg_mc.gotoAndStop(2);
         }
      }
   }
   if(hkk == false && (!zuopt1_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && !zuopt2_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && !youpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && !shangpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)))
   {
      hkk = true;
   }
   if(hkk == false && zuopt2_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && shangpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true))
   {
      hkk = true;
      trace("2zuo");
   }
   if(hkk == false && zuopt1_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && shangpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true))
   {
      hkk = true;
      trace("1zuo");
   }
   if(hkk == false && youpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && shangpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true))
   {
      hkk = true;
   }
   if(hkk == false && zuopt1_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && (qgg_mc.pb.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || qgg_mc.pb1.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)))
   {
      hkk = true;
      trace("fsd");
   }
   if(hkk == false && zuopt2_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && (qgg_mc.pb.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || qgg_mc.pb1.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)))
   {
      hkk = true;
      trace("fsd");
   }
   if(hkk == false && youpt_mc.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) && (qgg_mc.pb.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true) || qgg_mc.pb2.hitTest(ljk.x,ljk.y,true)))
   {
      hkk = true;
   }
};
xingxing = function()
{
   var _loc1_ = this;
   if(w == 1)
   {
      w--;
   }
   else
   {
      w++;
   }
   xxx++;
   xx1 = _loc1_.attachMovie("x" + w,"xx" + xxx,xxx);
   xx1._x = -100 + random(80) * 5;
   xx1._y = -120 + random(200);
   xx1.swapDepths(qmm_mc);
   king.addEventListener("onzhu",xx1);
   xx1.onzhu = function()
   {
      if(this.di1.pb.hitTest(qmm_mc.pb))
      {
         this.di1.gotoAndStop(2);
      }
   };
};

var gb1 = 0;
gbxx = function()
{
   var _loc1_ = this;
   gb1 = _loc1_.attachMovie("guoban","guobann",10000);
   gb1._x = -100 + random(400);
   gb1._y = -120 + random(150);
   king.addEventListener("onzhu",gb1);
   gb1.onzhu = function()
   {
      if(this.pb.hitTest(qmm_mc.pb))

         shudu = 0;
         if(wmm_mc._currentframe != 4)
         {
            qmm_mc.gotoAndStop(4);

      }
   };

qgg_mc.cjwk._visible = false;
xsj = function()
{
   var _loc1_ = _parent;
   var zcsj = getTimer();
   var jz = 900;
   var bz = 6000;
   var gbx = 180000;
   var _loc2_ = Object();
   king.addEventListener("onzhu",_loc2_);
   _loc2_.onzhu = function()
   {
      var _loc1_ = _parent;
      if(zcsj + jz - getTimer() < 0)
      {
         jsxing();
         jz += 30000;
      }
      if(zcsj + bz - getTimer() < 0)
      {
         bzxing();
         bz += 60000;
      }
      _loc1_.zs = _loc1_.fs1 + _loc1_.fs2 + _loc1_.fs5 + _loc1_.fs10;
      if(caoji && qmm_mc._currentframe <= 2)
      {
         shudu = 15;
         z = 50;
         qmm_mc.gotoAndStop(2);
         qgg_mc.cjwk._visible = true;
      }
      if(caoji)
      {
         if(csj + 6000 - getTimer() < 0)
         {
            if(qmm_mc._currentframe <= 2)
            {
               caoji = false;
               shudu = 10;
               z = 30;
               qmm_mc.gotoAndStop(1);
               qgg_mc.cjwk._visible = false;
            }
         }
      }
      if(!qmm_mc.pb.hitTest(bg))
      {
         if(qmm_mc._currentframe < 3)
         {
            qmm_mc.gotoAndStop(3);
            shudu = 0;
         }
      }
   };
};
xsj();
var js = 400;
jsxing = function()
{
   var _loc2_ = this;
   var _loc1_ = 0;
   js++;
   _loc1_ = _loc2_.attachMovie("js","jss" + js,js);
   _loc1_._x = -100 + random(300);
   _loc1_._y = -120 + random(150);
   _loc1_.swapDepths(qmm_mc);
   king.addEventListener("onzhu",_loc1_);
   _loc1_.onzhu = function()
   {
      if(this.j.jss.jsss.pb.hitTest(qmm_mc.pb) && !caoji)
      {
         caoji = true;
         csj = getTimer();
         removeMovieClip(this);
      }
   };
};
var b = 500;
bzxing = function()
{
   var _loc2_ = this;
   var _loc1_ = 0;
   b++;
   _loc1_ = _loc2_.attachMovie("zdx","zdxx" + b,b);
   _loc1_._x = 50;
   _loc1_._y = -120 + random(150);

   _loc1_.onzhu = function()
   {

         qmm_mc.gotoAndStop(5);
         shudu = 0;
         removeMovieClip(this);
      }
   };
};
var ghj = getTimer();
var mlj = 1000;
this.onEnterFrame = function()
{
   var _loc1_ = _parent;
   if(getTimer() - bgf > 0 && xs < 4)
   {
      bgf += 600;
      xingxing();
      if(xs <= 2)
      {
         xingxing2();
      }
      if(xs <= 2)
      {
         xingxing5();
      }
      if(xs < 1)
      {
         xingxing10();
      }
      xs++;
   }
   if(shijiantiao_mc._currentframe == 99)
   {
      if(_loc1_.zs > _loc1_.wcfs)
      {
         mlj -= 200;
         _loc1_.wcfs += 200;
         djj++;
      }
      else
      {
         _loc1_.gotoAndStop(6);
      }
      if(djj == 4)
      {
         gbxx();
      }
      shijiantiao_mc.nextFrame();
   }
   if(getTimer() - ghj > 0)
   {
      ghj += mlj;
      shijiantiao_mc.nextFrame();
   }
   if(shudu > 10 && qmm_mc._currentframe == 1)
   {
      trace("j");
      shudu -= 1;
   }
   gb();
   penzhuang();
   qmmyd();
   trace(shudu);
};
